description: Scripting bind variables: :var in IF conditions, EXECUTE IMMEDIATE of a string variable, RETURN of a variable's text. Converted 1:1 from features/DeclareBlockReturnTest and ExecuteImmediateBindVarTest (both now retired).

steps.sql: DECLARE dyn_sql STRING DEFAULT 'SELECT 1 as c'; BEGIN   EXECUTE IMMEDIATE :dyn_sql;   RETURN dyn_sql; END
DECLARE q STRING DEFAULT 'SELECT n FROM bind_t'; BEGIN   RETURN q; END
